summary: Implemented the stubbed and deleted chardet 5.0.0 logic under chardet/: prober base methods and properties, coding-state and character-distribution analyzers (including Japanese context analysis), UniversalDetector feed/close with BOM, UTF-16/32 and escape-sequence handling, Hebrew and Latin-1 probers, and the chardetect CLI, plus fixes to multibyte analyzer alignment, context-confidence gating, one UTF-8 state-table transition (F0 followed by 90-9F), and detect_all skipping probers that ruled themselves out. The last full-suite run was 376 passed, 7 xfailed, 0 failed (exit 0), and repeated runs of the hypothesis tests also passed.
